name: Backblaze B2 MCP
description: Exposes Backblaze B2 cloud storage to agents through 40 tools spanning native B2 operations, S3-compatible data plane calls, and bucket analytics.

skills.name: Bucket Operations
skills.description: Creates, lists, and configures B2 buckets and their lifecycle rules through native Backblaze API calls.

skills.name: S3 Data Plane
skills.description: Uploads, downloads, copies, and deletes objects using S3-compatible operations against B2 storage.

skills.name: Storage Analytics
skills.description: Reports bucket size, object counts, and usage breakdowns so agents can reason about storage cost and growth.
